text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate observed in eu-west routing lane (5xx spike). P95 latency increased. Paging on-call @alice (primary-ingest).

alice: I'm on it. grabbing logs from the routing tier. any immediate customer pages?

ben: @alice getting a page from a customer on chat generation errors ~ 10:12 UTC. Customers show 503s.

carol: I'm here — looking at the console. Seems like failover kicked for several routes and traffic spilled into eu-central.

alice: Handoff to @ben (network) and @frank-sre for infra-side trace. frank, can you confirm whether the regional gateway started returning 502s?

frank-sre: Confirmed. edge-gw-eu-west began 502s at ~2155007830 and increased until 2155007900. Kernel logs show connection resets to dedicated backends. Dumping short trace below.

frank-sre: ```
[2155007830] gw-eu-west conn_reset backend-12
[2155007841] gw-eu-west conn_reset backend-14
[2155007850] backend-12 OOM-kill? mem_free low
[2155007865] failover triggered to eu-central variant
```

dave: I see autoscaler in eu-west triggered extra nodes but new nodes failed healthchecks against the routing shim (L7). Suspect a packaging/regression in the new serving shim.

eva: Running quick grep on deploy history — there was a canary push 2155007800 with shim v2.13.4. Canary failed but rollback apparently didn't complete due to a race; traffic flagged for fallback policy.

maya: Can we confirm fallback policy behavior? Our routing policy should prefer local model variant then fallback to cached LRU or buddy region only when capacity constraints present. Hypothesis: fallback triggered earlier than intended and selected eu-central model variant with incompatible quantization causing 5xx.

alice: Good hypothesis. @ops-bot, attach policy decision logs for the timeframe.

ops-bot: Attached routing_decisions.log (excerpt):
```
2155007835 decision: route->local (fail) -> attempt fallback region eu-central (policy: spillover=enabled, prefer_variant=compatibility_score)
2155007836 decision: selected variant: model-x-q2 (compat_score=0.6) -> proxy_connect failed status=502
2155007840 decision: increment spillover_counter cluster=eu-west -> trigger autoscale
```

ben: So chain: canary shim injected bad behavior -> local backends become unhealthy -> routing policy spillover responds -> selected fallback variant incompatible -> clients see 5xx. That tracks with the customer reports.

carol: I pulled RPC logs from model-x-q2 in eu-central: it is returning mismatch errors, e.g., tokenization exceptions. Looks like quantization mismatch between runtime and model.

alice: Immediate mitigation: 1) block model-x-q2 as fallback variant for eu-west routing (policy override), 2) force rollback of shim to v2.13.3 in eu-west, 3) ensure healthcheck retries extended to avoid premature failovers. Who will take each?

frank-sre: I'll push the policy override — adding deny rule for model-x-q2 for eu-west spillover. Doing a hotfix now.

maya: I'll coordinate rollback of shim v2.13.4 canary -> promote v2.13.3 back. Expect ~4-6 minute window to rip traffic back.

eva: I'll update customer-facing incident page with current impact: ~12% of eu-west requests affected, elevated error rate 10:12–10:24 UTC, some customers with degraded chat UX.

alice: Apply mitigation, confirm metrics.

frank-sre: Policy override applied at 2155007935: "deny fallback variant model-x-q2 for region eu-west". Monitoring.

frank-sre: Metrics: error rate dropping from 14% -> 3% within 90s of policy override. Latency p95 trending down.

maya: Rollback completed at 2155007980. Healthchecks steady. Starting slow traffic restoration to local backends.

ben: Observed residual 503s until 2155008040; after that traffic fully local.

alice: Customer impact notes for timeline draft:
- 2155007830: Canary v2.13.4 rolled to eu-west canary pool
- 2155007841: Local backends start failing healthchecks (OOM-like signs)
- 2155007850: Autoscaler invoked -> new nodes fail healthchecks
- 2155007865: Routing policy spillover to eu-central (selected model-x-q2)
- 2155007900: Customers report 503/502 errors; paging triggered
- 2155007935: Hotfix: deny model-x-q2 fallback in eu-west
- 2155007980: Rollback to v2.13.3 completed
- 2155008040: Traffic stabilized; error rates normalized

carol: For RCA we should capture: why rollback didn't complete originally, why autoscaler introduced unhealthy nodes, and why fallback selection allowed incompatible variant.

maya: Action items:
- (P0) Ensure canary rollback path includes gating that cancels in-flight routing decisions (owner: maya, ETA 48h)
- (P0) Add compatibility check to fallback selection that enforces runtime-quantization compatibility >= 0.8 (owner: alice, ETA 72h)
- (P1) Harden healthcheck of new nodes to validate L7 shim handshake before joining LB (owner: frank-sre, ETA 1w)
- (P2) Postmortem writeup with customer timelines and mitigation (owner: eva, ETA 24h)

ben: I'm attaching a small log bundle for the window (pasted snippets):
```
-- gw-eu-west tail --
[2155007829] POST /v1/generate -> 200
[2155007834] POST /v1/generate -> 502
[2155007836] POST /v1/generate -> 502
[2155007842] healthcheck backend-12 -> FAIL
[2155007851] autoscaler add node node-958
[2155007856] node-958 healthcheck -> FAIL
```

alice: Confirmed. Hypothesis ranking: 1) Regression from shim v2.13.4 caused local backend instability -> highest confidence. 2) Fallback selection lacked strong compatibility gating -> medium confidence. 3) Autoscaler node image missing L7 shim artifacts causing join failures -> lower confidence but plausible.

frank-sre: Will attach kernel OOM traces and container logs to the postmortem doc.

eva: I'll open the postmortem and link logs + timeline. Draft will include customer list impacted and suggested communication.

carol: One more protective follow-up: add a canary-to-prod cool-down that prevents routing-policy from spilling traffic off-region until healthchecks sustain for X minutes (proposed 2 min). Owner: carol, ETA 1w.

alice: Good. Any objections to closing the page as mitigated? We have rollback + policy override in place and metrics normalized.

ben: No objections. I'll stay on watch for next 30m then sign off.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rate returned to baseline, incident status -> mitigated.

alice: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread as the working RCA coordination thread and move findings into the official postmortem doc.

-- end of thread --"
